analyst.summary: Urban Company operates a fast-growing online marketplace for home and personal services, with revenue up nearly 40% over the last year and a new instant-service offering scaling quickly. However, operating losses have widened rather than narrowed as the company has grown -- margins moved from roughly -3.5% to -20% year-on-year -- which is the opposite of what investors typically want to see from a scaling platform business, and the stock still trades at a premium to book value. We rate this a Sell until the margin trend turns around.
